lines.t: Who, who, yeah, I'm coming home
I was lost in the neon haze, drifting far away
Counting minutes, counting hours in a world of grey
Your voice, it echoes like a melody
I used to know, breaking through the static
Everywhere I go
One step, two steps closer to the flame
I'm calling out your holy name
The shadows fade, the heart begins to beat
I lay my heavy crown down at your feet
Neon grace, you're the fire in the dark
Save our love, you're the beating in my heart
I'm running, I'm running, I'm running
And back to you
Everything is cold
Everything is new
Back to the light
Out of the night
No more masks
No more hiding in the crowd
Your mercy screaming out
It's singing loud
From the valley to the mountain, I can see the view
Every road I've taken leads me straight to you
Faith, hope, love, reign over me
Grace, truth, life, I'm finally free
You're the alpha, the omega, the start and the end
My savior, my king, and my closest friend
Me of grace
You're the fire in the dark
Say, my love, you're the beating in my heart
I'm running, I'm running, I'm running back to you
Everything is gold, everything is new
Back to you
My turn to love
